user.title: GdAAuto
user.description: What make is your car? If GdAAuto can read it from its cloud it signs in there; otherwise it tells you which Home Assistant integration to use, and reads it from that.

home_assistant.title: {marchio} from Home Assistant
home_assistant.description: GdAAuto cannot read this make from its cloud yet. First install **{integrazione}** ([here]({link})), then pick the car's device: GdAAuto suggests the entities by itself.

entita.title: The car's entities
entita.description: I recognised {trovate}. Check and fix them: only the battery is required.

reauth_tesla.title: Sign in to Tesla again
reauth_tesla.description: Tesla no longer accepts GdAAuto's access. Sign in again with the same account.

stellantis.title: Stellantis
stellantis.description: Which app do you use for your car? Fiat, Jeep, Alfa Romeo and Lancia use another cloud: for them pick “It's already in Home Assistant”.

stellantis_paese.title: {marchio}
stellantis_paese.description: The account's country: it decides which site you sign in from.

stellantis_codice.title: Sign in to your account

data.cert_app: App certificate (optional: downloaded automatically if left empty)
data.cert_app_file: …or upload your own certificate (PEM, DER or .p12)
data.chiave_app: App key (optional: downloaded automatically if left empty)
data.chiave_app_file: …or upload your own key (PEM, DER or .p12)

conferma_dispositivo.title: {marchio}
conferma_dispositivo.description: Open [this link]({link}), sign in and confirm the code **{codice}**. Then come back here and press Submit.

error.certificato: The certificate or key is missing, cannot be read, or is rejected by the cloud.
error.rete: The cloud does not respond. Try again shortly.
error.nessuna_auto: The account has no cars, not even shared ones.
error.gia_gdaauto: This is already a GdAAuto device: pick the one from the car's own integration.
error.batteria: At least the battery is required.
error.codice: The code is invalid or expired. Sign in again and paste the new one.
error.in_attesa: Not confirmed yet: confirm the code on the website and try again.
error.codice_inviato: A verification code was sent to you (by email or SMS): type it in the “Code” field and submit again.
error.codice_sbagliato: The verification code is wrong or expired: check it, or leave the field empty to get a new one.
error.file: The uploaded file is not a certificate or a key that can be opened (PEM, DER, or PKCS#12 without a password).
error.pin: The PIN is not correct: check it in the app, or leave it empty and GdAAuto will read the car without commanding it.

abort.already_configured: This car or account is already set up.
abort.rete: The cloud does not respond. Try again shortly.
abort.account_diverso: You signed in with a different account.
abort.missing_credentials: The Tesla developer app credentials are missing: add them in Settings → Devices & services → Application credentials.
abort.missing_configuration: The Tesla developer app credentials are missing.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Tesla did not return the sign-in link in time.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no address Tesla can return to.
abort.oauth_error: Tesla returned a token that cannot be read.
abort.oauth_timeout: Signing in with Tesla took too long.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Tesla does not authorise the access.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: You declined the access on Tesla.

create_entry.default: Done: the car is in GdAAuto.

init.title: GdAAuto
init.description: The PIN is needed for Leapmotor commands. Teslas from 2021 need signed commands: set the official tesla-http-proxy. Remote unlock stays off until you enable it here.

data.intervallo_minuti: How often to read the parked car
data.intervallo_in_moto_secondi: How often while driving or charging
data.risparmio: Read less often when locked and unplugged

options.destinazione: Send a destination to the car's navigation

comando_spento.message: The “{comando}” command is not available for this car, or it is disabled in the GdAAuto options.

invia_destinazione.name: Send a destination
invia_destinazione.description: Sends an address to the car's navigation.

aggiorna.name: Refresh
aggiorna.description: Reads the car now (at most every 30 seconds).

application_credentials.description: The Tesla developer app credentials, from {developer}. In the app, the redirect address must be {redirect}.
